digest.component_or_area: reconciler read/check paths and operation runtimes
propositions: Reconciler read/check paths currently call load_config() and inspect environment/cwd, allowing ambient settings to mutate read scope or discard supplied registry config during operation execution
Jira backend construction from ambient environment properties can reload settings that should remain stable for the duration of a single reconcile-check or dry-run operation

Reconciler must construct exactly one selected Jira backend (Cloud or Data Center, never both) with immutable project/query scope, TLS, timeout/limits, and auth bindings derived from supplied configuration
Supplied custom tracker directory, branch, and remote must determine every observed read/ref/query owner across preflight, fetch, diff, mapping, and binding lookup paths without ambient reload
Missing/conflicting auth, empty project/query scope, or malformed config must fail before any Jira model request or local write, with no fallback to anonymous or cross-provider authentication
